translation_snapshot.source: Never Look Back And There Again
Reavers are terrible foes, charging their enemies with a weapon in each hand.
translation_snapshot.target: 收割者是一个恐怖的对手，他可以向敌人挥舞两把单手武器。

translation_snapshot.source: You have taken upon yourself to cleanse it and deal a crippling blow to the orcs.
translation_snapshot.target: 你决定自己行动，清理了它，对兽人造成了致命的打击。

translation_snapshot.source: It looks at you with cute little eyes before jumping at you with razor sharp teeth.
translation_snapshot.target: 它用无辜的眼神看着你，同时用剃刀般锋利的牙齿扑向你。

translation_snapshot.source: Try to get any knots out before returning. Wear gloves.
translation_snapshot.target: 在回来之前把打结在上面的其他蠕虫统统清理掉。戴上手套。

translation_snapshot.source: A thought can inspire; a thought can kill. After centuries of oppression, years of imprisonment, a thought shall break us free and vengeance will strike from our darkest dreams.
translation_snapshot.target: 思想可以鼓舞人，思想也能杀人，在几个世纪的压抑、数年的监禁之后，我们心中的复仇思想会从我们最黑暗的梦境中爆发。
